R_ARCH_SOURCE_BRIDGE.name: All-width local diagram, polynomial vacuum, and source interpolation proof

C9000237.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 237 (The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk.; papers: Radial transfer estimates and polygon length laws for honeycomb walks; Critical honeycomb chords with prescribed boundary endpoints; Cylinder loop weights and planar nesting; Mass and covering exponents for fixed-length honeycomb walks; Signed cylinder propagation and marked polygons on the honeycomb lattice; Cylinder amplitudes and logarithmic bridge-length windows on the honeycomb lattice; Marked polygon correlations and one-arc bounds; Disk transfer representations and confined bridge mass; Polynomial vacuum representations and bridge mass for honeycomb walks; Renewal and changes of law for critical honeycomb walks; Critical strip-crossing mass on the honeycomb lattice; Uniform marked-polygon estimates and sharp finite bridge moments; Cap-selected amplitudes and triangle chords for honeycomb walks; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/237.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ARCH_AUDIT.statement: Certify an admissible exact obstruction or an all-width proof for Proposition prop:arch-formula, with independent review and no assertion about the exponent from an intermediate obstruction alone.

C_ARCH_FORMULA.statement: For every width, the physical arch moment equals the stated Pfaffian quotient coefficient, by the all-width proof in report.md; independent mathematical review is pending.

L_ARCH_CONVERGENCE.statement: At each fixed-width mixed physical/flat list, both restricted transfers have spectral radius less than one, giving regular stationary/source vectors and absolutely convergent path sums.

L_ARCH_TRANSFER.statement: Reconstruct the zero-loop vacuum and source column maps using the manuscript's nine diagrams and exact port ordering.

L_ARCH_REFLECTION.statement: Settle the diagrammatic reflected source projection at merge and deletion specializations without replacing diagrammatic transpose by coordinate transpose.

L_ARCH_GLUING.statement: Compute the occupancy- and connectivity-sensitive one-source gluing and justify its relation to the arch moment.

L_ARCH_PFAFFIAN.statement: Evaluate the scalar Pfaffian quotient coefficient by polynomial continuation, including coincident physical rapidities.

L_ARCH_DEGREE.statement: Verify or refute the passage from the polynomial vacuum degree bound to the degree bound for p_N squared times the arch moment.

L_ARCH_INTERPOLATION.statement: If the preceding obligations hold, establish the reductions and sufficient distinct interpolation roots for every width; otherwise certify the precise obstruction.

L_ARCH_SCALAR.statement: For every positive size, the continued Pfaffian is a symmetric polynomial with the stated degree, leading coefficient, and flat/merge/deletion rules; p_0=1 is a separate convention.

L_ARCH_VACUUM.statement: For every positive size, the deletion-node interpolant has no Laurent poles, has exponent bound 2N-2, and is stationary by the parity residual argument; hence it is p_N P_N. W_0=1 is a separate convention.

C_ARCH_RESOLVENT.statement: The general projection/insertion/adjoint-pairing implications have a Lean 4.31.0 compiler certificate with zero proof holes. Independent statement-fidelity review is still pending.

C_ARCH_INTERPOLATION.statement: Degree at most 2N and agreement on 4N-3 distinct nodes imply polynomial equality for N at least 2; proved as arch_interpolation in the compiled formal source.
